statement: If G is a connected graph such that G - v has a Hamiltonian cycle for every vertex v, then G itself has a Hamiltonian cycle.
definitions: Finite simple connected graph with at least 4 vertices; a Hamiltonian cycle is a cycle on at least 3 distinct vertices that visits every vertex exactly once (so K1 and K2 are not Hamiltonian). G-v is G with vertex v and its incident edges deleted.
